intents.definition: User repeatedly weighs the same foods and wants the scale to show nutrition for that portion directly on the device, without opening the app each time.
intents.exclusion_criteria: One-off weighing for a new recipe; nutrition checked only in the app after weighing.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Repeated weighing of fixed foods; nutrition visible on the scale itself.
intents.name: Weigh fixed foods, see nutrition on the scale

representative_quotes.text: [SYNTHETIC] I weigh the same breakfast every morning and wish the scale just remembered my oats.
[SYNTHETIC] The preset food button on the scale itself is the only reason I keep using it.
[SYNTHETIC] The best feature is seeing protein immediately after weighing, no phone needed.

intents.definition: User finds opening the app for every weighing too much friction and wants fewer phone steps in the daily routine.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Complaints about the app in general, unrelated to weighing steps.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Phone use during weighing is described as friction.
intents.name: Less phone use while weighing

representative_quotes.text: [SYNTHETIC] Opening the app for every single weigh-in is too much friction before coffee.
[SYNTHETIC] I just want to weigh and go; the phone step is the part I skip.
[SYNTHETIC] If the scale shows the numbers itself, I would not open the app at all during breakfast.

intents.definition: Setup, sync or preset reliability problems that block the core weighing task.
intents.exclusion_criteria: One-off user error with no repeat mention.
intents.name: Setup and sync friction (issue)

representative_quotes.text: [SYNTHETIC] My scale lost the preset after a week and I had to set everything up again.
[SYNTHETIC] The touch buttons do not work with wet hands, which is exactly when I am cooking.
[SYNTHETIC] The app sync failed three times this week and my history shows nothing.

note: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE ONLY. All quotes are fictional and written for this example; none are real user reviews, forum posts, or comments.
